name: Kimi Omou Yoru ni Kengeki o
source:
"...That day, I turned to face fate."

Due to a certain reason, middle school student  "Michinomiya Sousuke" had come to avoid kendo. But one day, his childhood friend Nogi Wakaba asks him to face kendo once again. As the needle of fate begins to turn, Sousuke turns to face his fate once more...

[Translated from the [url=https://return-0.booth.pm/items/1153213]official site[/url]]
